source: Netty's direct-memory limit on a gRPC bidirectional stream's messages, probed on the 9.2.0 oracle at a 4 MiB limit: a message of 4.19 MB, past the limit, is still read (the decoder copies each message out and releases the read buffers), only the 4 MiB gRPC message cap applies.

mask.reason: the oracle sits behind Docker's network, an address of its own
what the pool holds at the failure depends on the sizes the socket's reads came in
the client's address as the oracle sees it (Docker's gateway)
